title: Can General-Purpose Large Models Break Through Physical AI? He Xiaopeng Gives a Sober Answer: Physical-World Constraints Cannot Be Filled by Parameters Alone

content_html:
When OpenAI engineers use large models to control robotic arms to paint, and when industry leaders predict that general AI will "break through" the barriers of embodied intelligence within a year or two, the entire tech world is caught up in feverish expectations for "physical AI." It is as if, as long as model parameters are large enough, robots can immediately leave the lab and take over factories and homes.

However, at the recent XPeng Tech Day, He Xiaopeng, Chairman and CEO of XPeng Group, poured a bucket of cold water on this carnival. He clearly pointed out: **Compared with the digital world, AI applications in the physical world face much stricter constraints. Relying only on general large models cannot solve all the challenges of physical AI.**
